finding: Unhandled exception on JSON NaN/Infinity values — error-path DoS
target: FastAPI 1.0.0 /auth/login (and other Pydantic-bodied POST routes):8080
remediation: Reject JSON bodies containing NaN/Infinity/-Infinity at the middleware layer with a 400; ensure pydantic ValidationError handler returns 422 not 500.

finding: Hand-rolled JWT verifier ignores RFC 7515 `crit` header and `typ` claim — JOSE conformance gaps
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range — FastAPI 1.0.0 _verify_token() custom JWT impl:8080
remediation: Replace the hand-rolled JWT code with `pyjwt` or `python-jose` which handles `crit`, `typ`, and strict JSON parsing per RFC. Avoid implementing JOSE primitives by hand.

finding: SSRF→RCE lateral pivot: command injection on sibling 'vulnerable twin' container reachable through bypassed allowlist
target: GENESIS demo twin (vulnerable mode) at host.docker.internal:8088 → /api/diagnostics/ping
remediation: Decommission the deliberately-vulnerable twin OR enforce the same _HOST_RE regex used in patched mode; AND fix .10's SSRF allowlist (chain-2 pos 1).

finding: SSRF → cloud metadata credential exfiltration (full chain)
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range FastAPI 1.0.0 (DEMO_MODE=patched):8080
remediation: Resolve DNS first, validate ALL resulting IPs against private/loopback/link-local/reserved/unspecified ranges, and explicitly deny known cloud-metadata IPs. Strip FQDN trailing dot before comparison.

finding: End-to-end CRITICAL chain: unauth → admin → cross-tenant PII → cloud-credential theft
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range (FastAPI 1.0.0) — patched build, port 8080
remediation: Defense in depth: remove demo-mode endpoints from production builds, never serve source, harden SSRF filters to resolve hostnames, decouple role from data-scope, rotate the disclosed JWT secret immediately.

finding: SSRF → cloud metadata credential exfiltration (full chain)
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range FastAPI 1.0.0 (DEMO_MODE=patched):8080
remediation: Resolve DNS first, validate ALL resulting IPs against private/loopback/link-local/reserved/unspecified ranges, and explicitly deny known cloud-metadata IPs. Strip FQDN trailing dot before comparison.

finding: SSRF allowlist bypass via docker-DNS hostname grants read access to internal control plane (Replica Manager + bench-API)
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range FastAPI 1.0.0 / /api/fetch (patched mode):8080
remediation: Resolve hostname to IP via socket.getaddrinfo() BEFORE the private/loopback check; fail-closed on any docker-internal name.

finding: IDOR / horizontal+vertical privilege escalation on /api/accounts/{id}
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range (FastAPI 1.0.0) — patched build:8080
remediation: Decouple 'admin role' from 'cross-tenant read'; require an explicit scope/permission for cross-account access and audit every cross-tenant access.

finding: Unauthenticated admin JWT issuance via /auth/demo-token
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range (FastAPI 1.0.0) — patched build:8080
remediation: Delete /auth/demo-token in non-demo builds; tokens must only be minted after real authentication, and role must be derived server-side from a trusted user record.

finding: Full backend source code disclosure (no auth)
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range FastAPI 1.0.0
remediation: Delete /demo-artifacts/* routes; build production images without source files.

finding: JWTs lack exp/iat/nbf/jti claims — tokens are valid indefinitely and cannot be revoked
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range — FastAPI 1.0.0 (uvicorn, DEMO_MODE=patched):8080
remediation: Add `exp` (short, ≤15min), `iat`, `nbf`, `jti`, `iss`, `aud` claims at issuance; validate all of them at verification; maintain a jti revocation list for early invalidation; require TLS for token transport.

finding: JWT bearer tokens transmitted over cleartext HTTP — no TLS available on port 8080
target: GENESIS CISO demo range on uvicorn (port 8080 plain HTTP):8080
remediation: Front the service with TLS (nginx/Caddy/ALB), redirect 80→443, set HSTS preload, and refuse to accept JWTs over plaintext.

finding: JWTs lack exp/iat/nbf/jti claims — tokens are valid indefinitely and cannot be revoked
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range — FastAPI 1.0.0 (uvicorn, DEMO_MODE=patched):8080
remediation: Add `exp` (short, ≤15min), `iat`, `nbf`, `jti`, `iss`, `aud` claims at issuance; validate all of them at verification; maintain a jti revocation list for early invalidation; require TLS for token transport.

finding: Internal Replica Manager state disclosure via SSRF — replica IDs, compose-dir paths, base URLs
target: GENESIS Replica Manager 7.0.0 (FastAPI) reachable via host.docker.internal:3701
remediation: Add bearer-token auth to Replica Manager, network-isolate it from any service exposing user-controlled URL fetches.

finding: Application source code disclosure exposes hard-coded JWT signing secret
target: FastAPI 1.0.0 (GENESIS CISO demo range, mode=patched) on uvicorn:8080
remediation: Remove /demo-artifacts/source/* routes from prod, load JWT secret from env/KMS, rotate it immediately.

finding: JWT token forgery via leaked HMAC signing key (CWE-321 Hard-coded cryptographic key)
target: FastAPI 1.0.0 (GENESIS CISO demo range, mode=patched) on uvicorn:8080
remediation: Rotate JWT secret immediately, load from secret manager, and revoke all tokens.

finding: Broken authentication — anonymous admin token issuance via /auth/demo-token and /auth/login
target: FastAPI 1.0.0 (GENESIS CISO demo range, mode=patched) on uvicorn:8080
remediation: Delete the demo-token endpoint; require credential verification (password+MFA) in /auth/login before minting any token.

finding: Privileged endpoint access via forged admin role
target: FastAPI 1.0.0 /api/admin/metrics:8080
remediation: Authorize admin actions against a server-side admin list keyed on `sub`, not a self-asserted claim.

finding: IDOR — read arbitrary account via admin-role bypass
target: FastAPI 1.0.0 /api/accounts/{id}:8080
remediation: Require explicit impersonation header + audit log for cross-owner reads; do not blanket-grant admin.

finding: SSRF filter bypass via hostname (non-IP) — internal metadata service credential leak
target: FastAPI 1.0.0 /api/fetch (httpx):8080
remediation: Resolve hostname to IP first and apply private/loopback/link-local/metadata blocks on the resolved IP; pin the IP into the actual HTTP call to defeat DNS rebinding.

finding: SSRF filter bypass via hostname (non-IP) — internal metadata service credential leak
target: FastAPI 1.0.0 /api/fetch (httpx):8080
remediation: Resolve hostname to IP first and apply private/loopback/link-local/metadata blocks on the resolved IP; pin the IP into the actual HTTP call to defeat DNS rebinding.

target: GENESIS CISO demo range FastAPI 1.0.0 (DEMO_MODE=patched) on uvicorn:8080
remediation: Load the JWT key from a secret store (env/Vault), rotate it immediately, and remove the /demo-artifacts/source/* route that ships server source publicly.

finding: Unauthenticated administrator-role JWT issuance via /auth/demo-token and /auth/login
target: GENESIS CISO demo range FastAPI 1.0.0 (DEMO_MODE=patched) on uvicorn:8080
remediation: Remove /auth/demo-token entirely; require credential verification in /auth/login and derive role server-side from the user record, never from the request body.

finding: Server source code disclosure via /demo-artifacts/source/app/main.py
target: GENESIS CISO demo range FastAPI 1.0.0 on uvicorn:8080
remediation: Delete the /demo-artifacts/source/* routes and /demo-artifacts/source-index.json from production deployment; rotate any secrets that ever appeared in source.

finding: Unauthenticated admin JWT mint via /auth/demo-token & /auth/login
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range — FastAPI 1.0.0 (uvicorn, DEMO_MODE=patched):8080
remediation: Delete /auth/demo-token; require password authentication on /auth/login; derive `role` server-side from a user-store lookup, never from request input.

finding: JWT signing secret disclosed in public source artifact enables offline admin-token forgery
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range — FastAPI 1.0.0 (uvicorn, DEMO_MODE=patched):8080
remediation: Remove all /demo-artifacts/* source-serving routes from production. Move JWT secret to a secret manager. Rotate the leaked secret and invalidate outstanding tokens.

target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range — FastAPI 1.0.0
remediation: Remove the admin short-circuit from the per-account endpoint; provide an explicit, audit-logged admin route for cross-tenant reads with break-glass approval.

remediation: Resolve hostnames before SSRF allow/deny; replace shell=True echo with safe string interpolation gated by a regex; remove vulnerable twin from any network reachable via SSRF pivot.

target: GENESIS CISO demo range FastAPI 1.0.0 on uvicorn:8080
remediation: Add exp/iat/nbf/iss/aud validation (or use PyJWT's `decode(..., audience=..., issuer=..., require=['exp','iat'])`); set issuance to mint short-lived tokens (≤15 min) and add a refresh-token flow with server-side revocation list.
